findings.text: follow-on: _committed_review_rounds reads the already-committed rounds from record.get("repo") while the sibling write at reckon/crew/promotion.py:1264 stores them under ledger_root (promotion.py:656), an explicit root when crew complete is given one; when those differ the already-committed skip reads a different tree than the one being written, so a committed round can still be rewritten and its disposition dropped — the defect this node fixes.
